research.title: Predictive Calibration Under Changing Missingness Patterns
bullets: Formulated whether changes in feature missingness degrade predictive calibration, and led development of a recalibration procedure conditioned on missingness indicators.
Evaluated the procedure against global recalibration using simulated missingness mechanisms, examining reliability diagrams and sensitivity to sparse calibration groups.

research.title: Stable Importance Weighting for Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated how unstable density ratios affect uncertainty estimation under covariate shift, and led development of regularized weighting for conformal prediction.
Developed weight clipping and diagnostic procedures, comparing interval coverage and width across controlled distribution shifts and tabular regression benchmarks.

publications.title: Regularized Importance Weighting for Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
Diagnosing Density Ratio Instability in Shifted Regression Problems

work.title: Input Validation and Batch Processing Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for structured data imports, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and malformed records within existing processing workflows.
Added regression tests for reported parsing defects and revised error messages to support debugging and routine maintenance of batch processing jobs.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Regularized Linear Regression
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression pipelines with standardized predictors, selecting regularization parameters through cross validation on synthetic and tabular datasets.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability under correlated features, documenting how regularization choices affected variable selection and sensitivity to sampling variation.

projects.title: Probability Calibration for Imbalanced Classification
bullets: Implemented logistic regression and tree ensemble baselines, applying sigmoid and isotonic calibration using held out predictions from imbalanced classification datasets.
Compared calibration curves, Brier scores, and discrimination metrics across class proportions, checking whether calibration gains persisted under alternative data splits.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture and Centroid Clustering Comparisons
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixtures and a centroid clustering baseline, testing both on synthetic datasets with overlapping and elongated clusters.
Compared cluster assignments, initialization sensitivity, and held out mixture likelihood, examining how covariance restrictions changed fit and convergence behavior.
